Application Data.NAME: Sunrise Memorial Services, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunrise Memorial Services, Inc. provides a comprehensive range of funeral and cemetery services including traditional burial and cremation options, as well as memorialization products such as headstones and urns. Our experienced staff assists families with compassionate funeral arrangements, including embalming, memorial services, and grief counseling. We also offer customized memorial products and maintain a photo lab for on-site memorial photography services. Additionally, our facility ensures compliance with all environmental regulations to manage any potential hazards associated with our operations, prioritizing the dignity and respect of the families we serve.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 15, 2023, Sunrise Memorial Services, Inc. experienced a water damage incident in the embalming room due to a burst pipe, resulting in damage to equipment and supplies. The estimated total cost for repairs and replacements was $10,000. The claim was submitted to the insurance company and is currently open, with an ongoing assessment by the adjuster. Additionally, on September 5, 2023, there was a minor liability claim filed by a family regarding dissatisfaction with service, leading to a goodwill adjustment of $5,000; this claim is also open and under review.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL Listed, Fire-Rated, 3-Hour Protection
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing surrounding the premises, motion-activated lighting, and on-site watchpersons during off-hours for enhanced safety and theft prevention.
